propositions: The DC backend requires a transport satisfying rebar's TicketTransport role plus SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, and SupportsAbsenceProbe, built on pycontribs/jira to reuse hardened REST/auth/pagination logic rather than re-implementing with stdlib urllib.
The transport must be confined to an opt-in [jira-datacenter] extra with lazy imports so 'import rebar' stays dependency-free; missing the extra must raise a clear install-naming error.

Every transport method returns raw payload dicts matching the existing _jira_shape_contract assertions, never jira.Issue objects; HTTP errors are attempted exactly once while timeouts are retried per the documented 2s/5s backoff.

Configuration must fail loudly on malformed [tool.rebar.jira] settings; TLS verification is never disabled, non-https URLs are rejected unless allow_insecure=true is set, and certificate failures name the ca_bundle setting.

The NameIdentity user-search resolver must return (username, True, False) for real DC users authoritatively, and raise BackendAssigneeNotFoundError when applying an unknown assignee, with live coverage against the J5 harness proving end-to-end correctness.

Self-registration import in adapters/__init__.py must wire the DC backend into the registry so select_backend('jira-datacenter') resolves at runtime, verified by test as BackendRegistryError (not KeyError) when the import is absent.
